scenario: Create bounded proposal-only recovery choices when a synthetic M4 contract fixture invalidates a current planning assumption.

output.semantics: Two or three non-activating replan candidates with explicit constraint coverage.

dependent_tool_system.m4_boundary: RAG-backed business activation is unavailable; no state-changing tool is called.

failure_handling.invalid_input: Reject before model or tool invocation.
failure_handling.no_safe_candidates: Return an escalation; do not fabricate or weaken constraints.
failure_handling.activation_requested: Reject because M4 permits proposal-only output.

rules: Read only the supplied synthetic fixture.
Never write business state or activate a plan.
Never infer user facts or override immutable constraints.
